description: Residue allowlist for `tsx tools/build-addon/index.ts --check-residue`. After the build, every RXP / RestedXP / Rested XP occurrence (case-insensitive) in the text files of dist/Wayfinder must fall in one of these classes (first match wins); anything else fails the check with file:line. Paths are relative to the addon folder. 'region' is the lexer region of the hit (tools/inventory-ids/lex.ts), 'literal' a regex on the enclosing string literal or XML attribute value, 'line' a regex on the hit's line, 'span' a regex whose match on the line must cover the hit.

classes.reason: NOTICE.md and LICENSE must credit RestedXP and link the upstream repo (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 attribution).
Bundled third-party libraries are shipped verbatim (rebrand.json 'verbatim').
Lua, XML and TOC comments are not shipped behaviour and are left as upstream wrote them (keeps the upstream diff small); includes the generated-TOC header naming the upstream commit.
Guide TEXT in RegisterGuide long strings: upstream content, kept byte-identical, including cRXP_* colour markup and #group names such as 'RestedXP Forever Dungeon Guide (H)'.
Guide colour markup (|cRXP_WARN_...|r) written in engine strings, the colour keys addon.guideTextColors is indexed by, and the Lua pattern that finds them. Must match unrenamed guide text.

Upstream guide group names, their translations and the Lua patterns / constants that match them (GuideLoader.lua, GuideWindow.lua, UI/V2/GuideConfigurator.lua, DB/*): functional, they must equal the #group lines of the unrenamed guide text, and they credit RestedXP as author of those guides.
GuideLoader.lua compares the first 8 characters of a guide group with "RestedXP" to detect upstream guide groups.
Credits: upstream theme author field, and the CC BY-NC-SA attribution line in the options panel.
TOC lines naming upstream source files (RXPGuides.lua): file names are relative to the addon folder, so they cannot collide; renaming the files would enlarge every upstream merge.
TOC Notes credit the upstream addon.

File names of upstream texture assets under Textures/ (rxp-borders, rxp_logo-64, ...). Paths are relative to the addon folder, so they cannot collide with RestedXP; renaming would mean renaming the binary files.
